Frequently Asked Questions

How does cash back work at {storeData.brand}?

When you click through CashHeros and make a purchase at {storeData.brand}, we earn a commission. We share this commission with you as cash back.

When will I receive my cash back?

Your cash back will appear as pending in your account within 7 days. It will become available for withdrawal after the store's return period (typically 30-90 days).

Can I use coupons and still earn cash back?

Yes! You can use {storeData.brand} coupons found on CashHeros and still earn cash back. However, using coupons from other sites may void your cash back.

Why is my cash back amount different than expected?

Cash back is calculated on the purchase amount before tax and shipping. Some items may be excluded from cash back, such as gift cards or certain brands.

What if my cash back doesn't track?

If your cash back doesn't appear within 7 days, you can submit a missing cash back claim from your account page.
